description: Log a play of a pinball game for the authenticated user. Use get_game_details first if you only have a slug — this tool needs the id from that response. playedAt must be today or earlier; at most 20 plays per game per day are accepted. Set dateKnown=false when the user has played the game but doesn't remember when or where; the diary will render "at some point". Returns playLogId, which kineticist_update_play_log and kineticist_delete_play_log take to change or remove this play. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

dateKnown.description: Defaults to true. Set to false when the play is a vague 'I played this at some point' claim with no real date.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

isReplay.description: Flag as a replay rather than first-time play

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

locationText.description: Freeform location name if locationId is unknown

playedAt.description: Play date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or earlier. Still required when dateKnown is false — send today's date as a placeholder.

score.description: Score on the machine, not a fun rating

name: kineticist_log_play
title: Log a play
